title: Composed supervisory control: Bounded up/down inventory counter -> Edge-counted batch with consecutive-reject lockout

inputs.name: A_Capacity
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Maximum count, assumed positive

inputs.name: B_Rejected
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Current item rejection flag

inputs.name: B_RejectLimit
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Consecutive rejects causing lockout

outputs.name: A_Conflict
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Add and Remove rose together

outputs.name: B_ConsecutiveRejects
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Current consecutive reject count

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: A_Capacity remains constant during a test and is positive.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: B_Target and B_RejectLimit remain constant during a test.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A lone rising A_AddItem edge increments A_Count when below A_Capacity.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_AddItem) AND !rose(A_RemoveItem) AND prev(A_Count)<A_Capacity AND !A_Reset) -> A_Count=prev(A_Count)+1)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A lone rising A_RemoveItem edge decrements A_Count when above zero.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_RemoveItem) AND !rose(A_AddItem) AND prev(A_Count)>0 AND !A_Reset) -> A_Count=prev(A_Count)-1)

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: Simultaneous rising edges shall leave A_Count unchanged and set A_Conflict for one scan.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_AddItem) AND rose(A_RemoveItem) AND !A_Reset) -> ((A_Count=prev(A_Count)) AND A_Conflict))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Count shall remain within zero and A_Capacity; A_Empty and A_Full reflect the boundaries.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear A_Count and A_Conflict.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Only a rising B_ItemPulse while not stopped, B_Complete, or locked shall count one item.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (count_change -> (rose(B_ItemPulse) AND !B_Stop AND !prev(B_Complete) AND !prev(B_LockedOut))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: An accepted item increments B_AcceptedCount and clears B_ConsecutiveRejects; a B_Rejected item increments both reject counters.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (accepted_edge -> (B_AcceptedCount=prev(B_AcceptedCount)+1 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=0))) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (rejected_edge -> (B_RejectCount=prev(B_RejectCount)+1 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=prev(B_ConsecutiveRejects)+1)))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Complete shall latch when B_AcceptedCount reaches positive B_Target and no later item may change counts.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Except for a qualified B_Reset scan, B_RejectLimit less than or equal to zero, or reaching B_RejectLimit consecutive rejects, shall latch B_LockedOut.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (((B_RejectLimit<=0 OR B_ConsecutiveRejects>=B_RejectLimit) AND !(B_Reset AND B_Stop AND !B_ItemPulse))->B_LockedOut))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Stop has priority over B_ItemPulse and prevents every count change.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset clears all state only while B_Stop is TRUE and B_ItemPulse is FALSE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Reset AND B_Stop AND !B_ItemPulse)->(B_AcceptedCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=0 AND !B_Complete AND !B_LockedOut)))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_Empty shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND B_AcceptedCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=0 AND NOT B_Complete AND NOT B_LockedOut)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (B_AcceptedCount=0 AND B_RejectCount=0 AND B_ConsecutiveRejects=0 AND NOT B_Complete AND NOT B_LockedOut))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
